independent_imagery_source.dataset: Benthic annotations of stereo-BRUV and drop camera imagery from the South-west Corner Marine Park
independent_imagery_source.provider: IMAS / University of Tasmania on behalf of University of Western Australia and NESP Marine and Coastal Hub Project 1.4

scoring.coordinate_discovery_rule: Identify latitude/longitude columns only from CSV schema and numeric domain; do not use annotation labels to choose or move candidate locations.
scoring.direct_image_support: At least one georeferenced imagery/annotation record at great-circle distance <= frozen candidate radius_m.
scoring.near_image_coverage: No direct record, but at least one georeferenced imagery/annotation record within 1000 m.
scoring.regional_image_coverage: No record within 1000 m, but at least one within 5000 m.
scoring.no_image_coverage: No georeferenced imagery/annotation record within 5000 m.
